mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen for four consecutive weeks from -9.1 to -3.4 percent below baseline, and this momentum will continue as mobility normalization persists, producing a higher mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved from -9.1 to -3.4 over the four weeks ending 2020-12-15
failure_condition: The mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility crossing above -28 percent below baseline signals a durable return of commuting and out-of-home trips that will lift retail-and-recreation footfall within one week, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -28.0 percent change from baseline for at least one week.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -31.9 to -27.7 over the four weeks ending 2020-12-15
failure_condition: TRANSIT remains above -28.0 but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The joint movement of TRANSIT recovery and RESIDENTIAL decline reflects a substitution from staying home to outside mobility, and their interaction will amplify retail-and-recreation activity over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -31.9 to -27.7 while RESIDENTIAL fell from 4.0 to 3.1 over four weeks
failure_condition: When TRANSIT improves and RESIDENTIAL declines jointly, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a continued phased reopening without new restrictions, falling TRANSIT deficits and stable WORKPLACES allow retail-and-recreation mobility to rise; the policy regime is the necessary condition for the recovery to persist.
candidate_trigger: No new city-wide lockdown or curfew is announced before 2021-01-12.
regime_hint: continued phased reopening with no new restrictions
failure_condition: A new lockdown or curfew is announced and RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained positive GROCERY_PHARM mobility above 5 percent indicates households remain in pandemic-provisioning mode, which will crowd out discretionary retail trips and keep RETAIL_REC below its recent four-week mean.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stays above 5.0 percent change from baseline for two consecutive weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose from 2.3 to 5.7 over the four weeks ending 2020-12-15
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM remains above 5.0 but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility staying below -6 percent below baseline means office commuting remains suppressed, removing weekday lunch and after-work retail footfall and pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES stays below -6.0 percent change from baseline for two consecutive weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES is -6.7 in both t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: WORKPLACES stays below -6.0 but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The December holiday shopping period will drive discretionary retail spending upward irrespective of mobility volatility, and the sharp PARKS decline into t-0w reinforces a shift toward indoor retail activity.
evidence_refs: fact:decision date 2020-12-15 falls in the December holiday shopping season
fact:PARKS fell from -10.0 to -16.4 between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days despite the December holiday period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp week-on-week PARKS drop combined with RESIDENTIAL remaining above baseline signals a retreat indoors, which will redirect local trips toward nearby retail-and-recreation venues and lift RETAIL_REC over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls more than 5 points week-on-week while RESIDENTIAL remains above 3.0.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from -10.0 to -16.4 while RESIDENTIAL stayed above 3.0
regime_hint: winter season with elevated at-home time
failure_condition: Under a PARKS weekly drop greater than 5 points and RESIDENTIAL above 3.0, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.
